ETHICS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 15, 2023
  400 W. BROADWAY
  POLICE DEPARTMENT COMMUNITY ROOM, 5:00 PM

Margo Morales, Chair  Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner
Barbara A. Pollack, Vice Chair  J. P. Shotwell, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Susan Wise, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 Note: Due to a technical issue, the audio recording of the meeting ends after approximately one hour.

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 5:03 PM, Chair Morales called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Añorve, De Benedictis, Shotwell, Wise, Pollack, Morales

 Also present: April Walker, Administrative Deputy City Manager, Heather Van Wijk, Ethics Officer,
 Jorge Godinez, Assistant to the City Manager, Atoy Wilson, Deputy City Attorney,
 Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  23-25750  Recommendation to conduct a study session to interview applicants for the Ethics
  Commission vacancy; and, if appropriate, appoint a member to the Ethics
  Commission, subject to completion of remaining City requirements.

  Chair Morales spoke.

  Chief Coleman spoke.

  Commissioner Shotwell joined the meeting.

  Kathryn Wells spoke.

  Andrea Gunn Eaton spoke.

  Chair Morales spoke.

  Dana Buchanan spoke.

Heather Van Wijk, Ethics Officer, spoke.

Chair Morales spoke.

Commissioner Shotwell spoke.

Commissioner Wise spoke.

Commissioner Añorve spoke.

A motion was made by Commissioner Añorve, seconded by Commissioner
De Benedictis, to approve recommendation, as amended, to appoint Jonathan
“Chief” Coleman to the Ethics Commission pending completion of the
commissioner onboarding process; and notify Andrea Gunn Eaton that they
have been selected as an alternate in the event the appointed applicant is
unable to complete the process. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  6 Añorve, De Benedictis, Shotwell, Wise, Pollack, Morales
No:  0 None
Recused: 0 None
